summary: The market ended the week with a modest relief bounce, closing near the day's highs. Large caps led, smallcaps edged up and midcaps slipped, so the rebound was narrow.

detail.leaders: Realty and auto (best sectors); Axis Bank, Asian Paints, M&M
detail.laggards: Nifty IT and Nifty Pharma (weakest sectors); Nifty MidCap 100 −0.14%
detail.tone: The final settle was a touch firmer than the closing-auction print, at Nifty 23,140.50 (+0.34%) and Sensex 73,895.74 (+315). That reclaims about a fifth of Thursday's 384-point fall after a morning spent chopping around 23,000–23,100.
